Deployment only, with no zero checks on any of the four wired addresses. Two chained registry views on every call. The answer is re-read per call rather than cached, so a rotation that rewrites the generation's quote changes which asset `_pullQuote` (CauldronGachaRouter.sol:271) demands from the very next caller, and a play that is in flight in the same block can be pointed at a different pool than the sender expected. DERIVED: nothing in this file stores the quote.

The gacha commit and resolve happen before any payout, so the two token sends at `_safeTransfer` (CauldronGachaRouter.sol:331) and `_payQuote` (CauldronGachaRouter.sol:338) are the last actions and the hook cannot be re-entered through a hostile recipient while state is half-written. Permissionless and payment-free: it opens crystals the caller already earned, clamped to the constant at `MAX_MINTS_PER_CALL` (CauldronGachaRouter.sol:347) and to the caller's own `maxCount` (CauldronGachaRouter.sol:348), and returns early when nothing is ready at `ready` (CauldronGachaRouter.sol:349). Open and empty, so any address can push ETH in. Such a balance is indistinguishable from a player's value once inside, and it is spendable by the native settle branch at `settle` (CauldronGachaRouter.sol:507) and by the owner at `rescueETH` (CauldronGachaRouter.sol:547).
